verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב רַגְלָ֑יו וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אַ֥רְצָה בְנֵי־ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ya·‘ă·qōḇ raḡ·lāw way·yê·leḵ ’ar·ṣāh ḇə·nê- qe·ḏem
verses.literal: Jacob resumed his journey . . . and came to the land of the people of the east
verses.literalPt: Jacó pôs-se a caminho e chegou à terra dos filhos do Oriente.

verses.original: וַיַּ֞רְא וְהִנֵּ֧ה בְאֵ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּה־ שָׁ֞ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶדְרֵי־ צֹאן֙ רֹבְצִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֚י מִן־ הַבְּאֵ֣ר הַהִ֔וא יַשְׁק֖וּ הָעֲדָרִ֑ים וְהָאֶ֥בֶן גְּדֹלָ֖ה עַל־ פִּ֥י הַבְּאֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar wə·hin·nêh ḇə·’êr baś·śā·ḏeh wə·hin·nêh- šām šə·lō·šāh ‘eḏ·rê- ṣōn rō·ḇə·ṣîm ‘ā·le·hā kî min- hab·bə·’êr ha·hi·w yaš·qū hā·‘ă·ḏā·rîm wə·hā·’e·ḇen gə·ḏō·lāh ‘al- pî hab·bə·’êr
verses.literal: He looked and saw a well in the field and near it . . . lay three flocks of sheep because the sheep were watered from this well And a large stone covered the mouth of the well
verses.literalPt: Olhou, e eis um poço no campo, e três rebanhos de ovelhas deitadas junto dele; pois desse poço é que se dava de beber aos rebanhos. Era grande a pedra que tapava a boca do poço.

verses.original: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣מָּה כָל־ הָעֲדָרִ֗ים וְגָלֲל֤וּ אֶת־ הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מֵעַל֙ פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֔ר וְהִשְׁק֖וּ אֶת־ הַצֹּ֑אן וְהֵשִׁ֧יבוּ אֶת־ הָאֶ֛בֶן עַל־ פִּ֥י הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִמְקֹמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·’es·p̄ū- šām·māh ḵāl hā·‘ă·ḏā·rîm wə·ḡā·lă·lū ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen mê·‘al pî hab·bə·’êr wə·hiš·qū ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣōn wə·hê·šî·ḇū ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen ‘al- pî hab·bə·’êr lim·qō·māh
verses.literal: When all the flocks had been gathered there the shepherds would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well
verses.literalPt: Ali se ajuntavam todos os rebanhos; e removiam os pastores a pedra da boca do poço, davam de beber às ovelhas e tornavam a pôr a pedra no seu lugar, sobre a boca do poço.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב אַחַ֖י מֵאַ֣יִן אַתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵחָרָ֖ן אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’a·ḥay mê·’a·yin ’at·tem way·yō·mə·rū mê·ḥā·rān ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: My brothers Jacob asked the shepherds where are you from We are from Haran they answered
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhes Jacó: Irmãos meus, donde sois? Responderam eles: Somos de Harã.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם הַיְדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ לָבָ֣ן בֶּן־ נָח֑וֹר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יָדָֽעְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem hay·ḏa‘·tem ’eṯ- lā·ḇān ben- nā·ḥō·wr way·yō·mə·rū yā·ḏā·‘ə·nū
verses.literal: Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor Jacob asked We know him they replied
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhes: Conheceis a Labão, filho de Naor? Responderam: Conhecemos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָהֶ֖ם הֲשָׁל֣וֹם ל֑וֹ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וְהִנֵּה֙ רָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔וֹ בָּאָ֖ה עִם־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem hă·šā·lō·wm lōw way·yō·mə·rū šā·lō·wm wə·hin·nêh rā·ḥêl bit·tōw bā·’āh ‘im- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: Is he well Jacob inquired Yes they answered and here comes his daughter Rachel with his sheep
verses.literalPt: Está ele bom? Continuou Jacó. Responderam: Está bom; eis que Raquel, sua filha, vem vindo com as ovelhas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵ֥ן עוֹד֙ הַיּ֣וֹם גָּד֔וֹל לֹא־ עֵ֖ת הֵאָסֵ֣ף הַמִּקְנֶ֑ה הַשְׁק֥וּ הַצֹּ֖אן וּלְכ֥וּ רְעֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hên ‘ō·wḏ hay·yō·wm gā·ḏō·wl lō- ‘êṯ hê·’ā·sêp̄ ham·miq·neh haš·qū haṣ·ṣōn ū·lə·ḵū rə·‘ū
verses.literal: Look said Jacob it is still broad daylight it is not yet time to gather the livestock Water the sheep and take them back to pasture
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes: É ainda muito dia, nem é tempo de se ajuntar o gado; dai de beber às ovelhas e ide apascentá-las.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ לֹ֣א נוּכַל֒ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֲדָרִ֔ים וְגָֽלֲלוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאֶ֔בֶן מֵעַ֖ל פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֑ר וְהִשְׁקִ֖ינוּ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lō nū·ḵal ‘aḏ ’ă·šer yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū kāl- hā·‘ă·ḏā·rîm wə·ḡā·lă·lū ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen mê·‘al pî hab·bə·’êr wə·hiš·qî·nū haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: But they replied We cannot . . . until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well Then we will water the sheep
verses.literalPt: Não o podemos, responderam eles, até que se ajuntem todos os rebanhos e seja removida a pedra da boca do poço; então, damos de beber às ovelhas.

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֖נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֑ם וְרָחֵ֣ל׀ בָּ֗אָה עִם־ הַצֹּאן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאָבִ֔יהָ כִּ֥י רֹעָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū mə·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mām wə·rā·ḥêl bā·’āh ‘im- haṣ·ṣōn ’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḇî·hā kî rō·‘āh hî
verses.literal: While he was still speaking with them Rachel arrived with her father’s sheep for she was a shepherdess
verses.literalPt: Estando Jacó ainda falando com eles, veio Raquel com as ovelhas de seu pai; porque ela as apascentava.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ רָאָ֨ה יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־ רָחֵ֗ל בַּת־ לָבָן֙ אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ וַיִּגַּ֣שׁ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַיָּ֤גֶל אֶת־ הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מֵעַל֙ פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֔ר וַיַּ֕שְׁקְ אֶת־ צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer rā·’āh ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- rā·ḥêl baṯ- lā·ḇān ’ă·ḥî ’im·mōw wə·’eṯ- ṣōn lā·ḇān ’ă·ḥî ’im·mōw way·yig·gaš ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yā·ḡel ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen mê·‘al pî hab·bə·’êr way·yašq ’eṯ- ṣōn lā·ḇān ’ă·ḥî ’im·mōw
verses.literal: As soon as Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban with Laban’s sheep he went up and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s . . . . . . . . . . . . sheep
verses.literalPt: Quando Jacó viu a Raquel, filha de Labão, irmão de sua mãe, chegou-se, removeu a pedra da boca do poço e deu de beber ao rebanho de Labão, irmão de sua mãe.

verses.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ק יַעֲקֹ֖ב לְרָחֵ֑ל וַיִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šaq ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·rā·ḥêl way·yiś·śā ’eṯ- qō·lōw way·yê·ḇək
verses.literal: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud
verses.literalPt: Então, Jacó beijou a Raquel e, levantando a voz, chorou.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד יַעֲקֹ֜ב לְרָחֵ֗ל כִּ֣י אֲחִ֤י אָבִ֙יהָ֙ ה֔וּא וְכִ֥י בֶן־ רִבְקָ֖ה ה֑וּא וַתָּ֖רָץ וַתַּגֵּ֥ד לְאָבִֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·rā·ḥêl kî ’ă·ḥî ’ā·ḇî·hā hū wə·ḵî ḇen- riḇ·qāh hū wat·tā·rāṣ wat·tag·gêḏ lə·’ā·ḇî·hā
verses.literal: He told Rachel that he was Rebekah’s . . . son . . . a relative of her father and she ran and told her father
verses.literalPt: Jacó contou a Raquel que ele era irmão de seu pai e que era filho de Rebeca; e ela, correndo, foi noticiá-lo a seu pai.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ לָבָ֜ן אֶת־ שֵׁ֣מַע׀ יַעֲקֹ֣ב בֶּן־ אֲחֹת֗וֹ וַיָּ֤רָץ לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיְחַבֶּק־ לוֹ֙ וַיְנַשֶּׁק־ ל֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיְסַפֵּ֣ר לְלָבָ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ lā·ḇān ’eṯ- šê·ma‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ben- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw way·yā·rāṣ liq·rā·ṯōw way·ḥab·beq- lōw way·naš·šeq- lōw way·ḇî·’ê·hū ’el- bê·ṯōw way·sap·pêr lə·lā·ḇān ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When Laban heard the news about his sister’s son Jacob he ran out to meet him He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home where Jacob told him all that had happened . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo Labão ouvido as novas de Jacó, filho de sua irmã, correu-lhe ao encontro, abraçou-o, e beijou-o e levou-o à sua casa. Relatou Jacó a Labão todas estas coisas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ לָבָ֔ן אַ֛ךְ עַצְמִ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֖י אָ֑תָּה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב עִמּ֖וֹ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw lā·ḇān ’aḵ ‘aṣ·mî ū·ḇə·śā·rî ’āt·tāh way·yê·šeḇ ‘im·mōw ḥō·ḏeš yā·mîm
verses.literal: Then Laban declared . . . You are indeed my own flesh and blood After Jacob had stayed with him a month . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Labão: Verdadeiramente, tu és meu osso e minha carne. E Jacó ficou com ele por espaço de um mês.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָבָן֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב הֲכִי־ אָחִ֣י אַ֔תָּה וַעֲבַדְתַּ֖נִי חִנָּ֑ם הַגִּ֥ידָה לִּ֖י מַה־ מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ hă·ḵî- ’ā·ḥî ’at·tāh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·ta·nî ḥin·nām hag·gî·ḏāh lî mah- maś·kur·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Laban said to him Just because you are my relative should you work for nothing Tell me what your wages should be
verses.literalPt: Depois, perguntou Labão a Jacó: Acaso, porque és meu irmão, deves, portanto, servir-me de graça? Dize-me que será o teu salário?

verses.original: וּלְלָבָ֖ן שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת שֵׁ֤ם הַגְּדֹלָה֙ לֵאָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַקְּטַנָּ֖ה רָחֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·lā·ḇān šə·tê ḇā·nō·wṯ šêm hag·gə·ḏō·lāh lê·’āh wə·šêm haq·qə·ṭan·nāh rā·ḥêl
verses.literal: Now Laban had two daughters the older was named Leah and the younger was named Rachel
verses.literalPt: Ora, Labão tinha duas filhas: o nome da mais velha era Lia, e o da mais moça, Raquel.

verses.original: וְעֵינֵ֥י לֵאָ֖ה רַכּ֑וֹת וְרָחֵל֙ הָֽיְתָ֔ה יְפַת־ תֹּ֖אַר וִיפַ֥ת מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·nê lê·’āh rak·kō·wṯ wə·rā·ḥêl hā·yə·ṯāh yə·p̄aṯ- tō·’ar wî·p̄aṯ mar·’eh
verses.literal: Leah had weak eyes but Rachel was shapely . . . and beautiful . . .
verses.literalPt: Lia tinha os olhos tenros, mas Raquel era formosa de porte e de semblante.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־ רָחֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶֽעֱבָדְךָ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים בְּרָחֵ֥ל בִּתְּךָ֖ הַקְּטַנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- rā·ḥêl way·yō·mer ’e·‘ĕ·ḇā·ḏə·ḵā še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm bə·rā·ḥêl bit·tə·ḵā haq·qə·ṭan·nāh
verses.literal: Since Jacob loved Rachel he answered I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel
verses.literalPt: E Jacó amava a Raquel e disse: Sete anos te servirei por ter a Raquel, tua filha mais moça.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֗ן ט֚וֹב תִּתִּ֣י אֹתָ֣הּ לָ֔ךְ מִתִּתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר שְׁבָ֖ה עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān ṭō·wḇ tit·tî ’ō·ṯāh lāḵ mit·tit·tî ’ō·ṯāh lə·’îš ’a·ḥêr šə·ḇāh ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: Laban replied Better that I give her to you than - to another Stay here with me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Labão: Melhor é que eu a dê a ti que a outro homem; fica comigo.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ד יַעֲקֹ֛ב בְּרָחֵ֖ל שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְעֵינָיו֙ כְּיָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֔ים בְּאַהֲבָת֖וֹ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·rā·ḥêl še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm way·yih·yū ḇə·‘ê·nāw kə·yā·mîm ’ă·ḥā·ḏîm bə·’a·hă·ḇā·ṯōw ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her
verses.literalPt: Assim, serviu Jacó sete anos por amor a Raquel; e estes lhe pareciam como poucos dias, por causa do amor que lhe votava.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב אֶל־ לָבָן֙ הָבָ֣ה אֶת־ אִשְׁתִּ֔י כִּ֥י מָלְא֖וּ יָמָ֑י וְאָב֖וֹאָה אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- lā·ḇān hā·ḇāh ’eṯ- ’iš·tî kî mā·lə·’ū yā·māy wə·’ā·ḇō·w·’āh ’ê·le·hā
verses.literal: Finally Jacob said to Laban Grant me my wife for my time is complete and I want to sleep with her
verses.literalPt: Jacó disse a Labão: Dá-me minha mulher, pois os meus dias já se completaram, para que eu esteja com ela.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף לָבָ֛ן אֶת־ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ lā·ḇān ’eṯ- kāl- ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm way·ya·‘aś miš·teh
verses.literal: So Laban invited all the men of that place and prepared a feast
verses.literalPt: Reuniu, pois, Labão todos os homens do lugar e fez um banquete.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בָעֶ֔רֶב וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ לֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ אֵלָ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇā·‘e·reḇ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- lê·’āh ḇit·tōw way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯāh ’ê·lāw way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā
verses.literal: But when evening came Laban took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob and he slept with her
verses.literalPt: À tarde, tomou a Lia, sua filha, e trouxe-a a Jacó, que esteve com ela.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לָ֔הּ אֶת־ זִלְפָּ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑וֹ לְלֵאָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ שִׁפְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lā·ḇān lāh ’eṯ- zil·pāh šip̄·ḥā·ṯōw lə·lê·’āh ḇit·tōw šip̄·ḥāh
verses.literal: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maidservant
verses.literalPt: (Labão deu sua serva Zilpa por serva a Lia, sua filha).

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִנֵּה־ הִ֖וא לֵאָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ לָבָ֗ן מַה־ זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֔י הֲלֹ֤א בְרָחֵל֙ עָבַ֣דְתִּי עִמָּ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה רִמִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer wə·hin·nêh- hî lê·’āh way·yō·mer ’el- lā·ḇān mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā lî hă·lō ḇə·rā·ḥêl ‘ā·ḇaḏ·tî ‘im·māḵ wə·lām·māh rim·mî·ṯā·nî
verses.literal: When morning came there . . . was Leah What . . . have you done to me Jacob said to Laban Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you Why have you deceived me
verses.literalPt: Quando amanheceu, eis que era Lia; e perguntou Jacó a Labão: Que é isso que me fizeste? Porventura, não te servi eu por amor de Raquel? Por que, então, me enganaste?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן לֹא־ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בִּמְקוֹמֵ֑נוּ לָתֵ֥ת הַצְּעִירָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַבְּכִירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān lō- yê·‘ā·śeh ḵên bim·qō·w·mê·nū lā·ṯêṯ haṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh lip̄·nê hab·bə·ḵî·rāh
verses.literal: Laban replied It is not our custom . . . here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Labão: Não se faz assim em nossa terra, que se dê a mais moça antes da primogênita.

verses.original: מַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וְנִתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ גַּם־ אֶת־ זֹ֗את בַּעֲבֹדָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמָּדִ֔י ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע־ שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: mal·lê šə·ḇu·a‘ zōṯ wə·nit·tə·nāh lə·ḵā gam- ’eṯ- zōṯ ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·ḇōḏ ‘im·mā·ḏî ‘ō·wḏ še·ḇa‘- šā·nîm ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Finish this week’s celebration . . . and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work
verses.literalPt: Acabada a semana desta, depois te daremos também a outra pelo trabalho de outros sete anos que ainda me servirás.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יַעֲקֹב֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיְמַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ רָחֵ֥ל בִּתּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ya·‘ă·qōḇ kên way·mal·lê šə·ḇu·a‘ zōṯ way·yit·ten- lōw ’eṯ- rā·ḥêl bit·tōw lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: And Jacob did just that He finished the week’s celebration . . . and Laban gave . . . him his daughter Rachel as his wife
verses.literalPt: Assim fez Jacó e cumpriu a semana desta; Labão lhe deu por mulher Raquel, sua filha.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לְרָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔וֹ אֶת־ בִּלְהָ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑וֹ לָ֖הּ לְשִׁפְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lā·ḇān lə·rā·ḥêl bit·tōw ’eṯ- bil·hāh šip̄·ḥā·ṯōw lāh lə·šip̄·ḥāh
verses.literal: Laban also gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant
verses.literalPt: (Labão deu por serva a Raquel, sua filha, a sua serva Bila).

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ גַּ֣ם אֶל־ רָחֵ֔ל וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב גַּֽם־ אֶת־ רָחֵ֖ל מִלֵּאָ֑ה וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמּ֔וֹ ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע־ שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō gam ’el- rā·ḥêl way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ gam- ’eṯ- rā·ḥêl mil·lê·’āh way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ‘im·mōw ‘ō·wḏ še·ḇa‘- šā·nîm ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Jacob slept with . . . Rachel as well and indeed he loved Rachel more than Leah So he worked for Laban another seven years
verses.literalPt: Jacó conheceu também a Raquel e amava mais a Raquel do que a Lia; e serviu com Labão ainda outros sete anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ שְׂנוּאָ֣ה לֵאָ֔ה וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־ רַחְמָ֑הּ וְרָחֵ֖ל עֲקָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar Yah·weh kî- śə·nū·’āh lê·’āh way·yip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- raḥ·māh wə·rā·ḥêl ‘ă·qā·rāh
verses.literal: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved He opened her womb but Rachel was barren
verses.literalPt: Vendo Jeová que Lia era desprezada, fê-la fecunda; Raquel, porém, era estéril.

verses.original: וַתַּ֤הַר לֵאָה֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ רְאוּבֵ֑ן כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה כִּֽי־ רָאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּעָנְיִ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה יֶאֱהָבַ֥נִי אִישִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har lê·’āh wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw rə·’ū·ḇên kî ’ā·mə·rāh kî- rā·’āh Yah·weh bə·‘ān·yî kî ‘at·tāh ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇa·nî ’î·šî
verses.literal: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son and she named him . . . Reuben for she said The LORD has seen my affliction . . . Surely my husband will love me now
verses.literalPt: Concebeu Lia e deu à luz um filho, a quem chamou Rúben; pois disse: Porque Jeová atendeu à minha aflição; por isso, agora, me amará meu marido.

verses.original: וַתַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ שְׂנוּאָ֣ה אָנֹ֔כִי וַיִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י גַּם־ אֶת־ זֶ֑ה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tō·mer kî- šā·ma‘ Yah·weh kî- śə·nū·’āh ’ā·nō·ḵî way·yit·ten- lî gam- ’eṯ- zeh wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw šim·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son and she said Because the LORD . . . has heard that I am unloved He has given me this son as well So she named him . . . Simeon
verses.literalPt: Tendo concebido outra vez, deu à luz um filho; e disse: Porquanto soube Jeová que eu era desprezada, portanto, me deu também este filho; e chamou-lhe Simeão.

verses.original: וַתַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר עַתָּ֤ה הַפַּ֙עַם֙ יִלָּוֶ֤ה אִישִׁי֙ אֵלַ֔י כִּֽי־ יָלַ֥דְתִּי ל֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tō·mer ‘at·tāh hap·pa·‘am yil·lā·weh ’î·šî ’ê·lay kî- yā·laḏ·tî lōw šə·lō·šāh ḇā·nîm ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·mōw lê·wî
verses.literal: Once again Leah conceived and gave birth to a son and she said Now at last my husband will become attached to me because I have borne him three sons So . . . he was named . . . Levi
verses.literalPt: Concebeu ainda outra vez e deu à luz um filho; e disse: Agora, esta vez se unirá meu marido a mim, porque lhe tenho dado três filhos; portanto, lhe chamou Levi.

verses.original: וַתַּ֨הַר ע֜וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֗ן וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַפַּ֙עַם֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרְאָ֥ה שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד מִלֶּֽדֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tō·mer hap·pa·‘am ’ō·w·ḏeh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘al- kên qā·rə·’āh šə·mōw yə·hū·ḏāh wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ mil·le·ḏeṯ
verses.literal: And once more she conceived and gave birth to a son and said This time I will praise the LORD So . . . she named him . . . Judah Then Leah stopped having children
verses.literalPt: De novo concebeu e deu à luz um filho; e disse: Esta vez louvarei a Jeová. Portanto, lhe chamou Judá; e cessou de dar à luz.
